dct_creator_sm: City of Grande Prairie Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm: This layer displays data acquired from the City of Grande Prairie Open Data Portal. It shows all capital projects that have associated spatial information. Other data available in the attributes table include service, department, project name, fund, approved amount, and project description. This layer is used in the associated map and dashboard, both of which were created for presentation purposes to demonstrate the capabilities of ESRI dashboards in showing both spatial and non-spatial data.
